validationPolicy.final30Percent: Reserved untouched; evaluate once only after candidate settings are frozen.

executionEvidenceLast7Days.note: Paper estimates are not actual fills. Observed slippage is only measurable when a real fill price and timestamp are recorded.

allTime.methodology: Only approved paper signals are included. Outcomes use subsequent closed M5 candle OHLC: first stop/target touch, ambiguous if both touch in one candle, or timeout after 180 bars at candle close. Net R subtracts observed signal-time spread plus configured estimated slippage; commission is subtracted only when configured, otherwise reported net R excludes commission. No broker fills are assumed.
